items.title: Ron Carter — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Called Where? with Eric Dolphy, Mal Waldron, Charlie Persip, and George Duvivier.

ctx.x: Not really. At that time I was here and there was so much going on in New York. There were recording dates, there were jingle dates, there were … studios had bands in the studios at that time. Jazz was all over the place, so I think there wasn't that kind of camaraderie time in terms of what you mean. I met Joe Benjamin and at the time, my feeling is that every ten years or so, Broadway gets a conscience and they realize that there are not enough black people in the band. This was one of those moments. And Joe…
This is also the time when – speaking of Duvivier – I guess, you did an album as a leader. It was your first.
Called Where? with Eric Dolphy, Mal Waldron, Charlie Persip, and George Duvivier. Nice record.
